item.title: Four Clare Schools Added To Safe Routes Scheme
item.description: Four Clare schools have qualified for funding under the last round of the safe routes to school scheme. St Conaire’s in Shannon, Doora National School, Inchicronan National School in Crusheen and Kilrush Community School have all been added to programme. item.title: Survey Launched To Enhance Connection To Clare Diaspora
item.description: A new programme will aim to enhance the connection of Clare’s town and villages to the diaspora abroad. The Western Development Commission is running an online survey from now until December 22nd that will aim to improve these links. It will examine current relationships fostered through festivals, GAA clubs, community events and other unique initiatives.
